secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://<project>.supabase.co) — backend for auth, DB, storage, edge functions. Found in Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public API key. Found in Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys (anon/public).

secrets.name: VITE_PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack public key for the credits/payments integration. Found in Paystack dashboard → Settings → API Keys → Public Key.

secrets.name: VITE_OPENWEATHER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenWeather API key for weather features. From https://openweathermap.org/api — sign up and copy your API key.

secrets.name: VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: VAPID public key for web push notifications. Generate via the Supabase push notification setup or web-push CLI.

secrets.name: VITE_SENTRY_DSN
secrets.description: Sentry DSN for error monitoring. From Sentry → Project Settings → Client Keys. Optional.
